verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a search engine, but the evidence pack never documents a self-hosted or on-prem deployment of Algolia's engine. The evidence describes Algolia as a platform providing hosted APIs, and a former customer cites its closed-source license as a reason for leaving. With no documented self-host option, the verdict is none.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can self-host the full engine — same features as the hosted product — on my own infrastructure
